name: print-social-peach-highway-sign-invest-in-stocks-illustrated-ad
title: Highway Sign Invest in Stocks Illustrated Ad
whatItIs: A portrait ad on dotted peach with two grey poles holding a bright purple highway sign with a white border reading 'You've crossed this city a thousand times.', a line 'One route you haven't taken yet: the NGX. Take your position, invest in stocks.', a boxed licence strip, purple hills, a blue horizon and a black road with dashed lines, and the wordmark with App Store and Google Play badges.
whatItMeans: Turning the ad into a road sign makes a familiar object carry a fresh idea, and a flat illustrated road leads the eye to the download buttons.
techniques: Copy set on an illustrated highway sign
Road with vanishing perspective leading to the CTA
Flat layered hills and horizon bands
Store badges as the base call to action

vocabulary.definition: Copy placed on an illustrated road or street sign.
Lines converging toward a point on the horizon.
A boxed line stating licences and partners.
